name: M5.PeriodSearch.finite_search_member
statement: ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.PeriodSearch.finiteSearch F ∈ M5.PeriodSearch.candidates F
context:
theorem M5.PeriodSearch.candidate_nonempty : ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → (M5.PeriodSearch.candidates F).Nonempty := by
  change ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → (M5.PeriodSearch.candidates F).Nonempty
  intro F hmonic hcoeff
  classical
  obtain ⟨hpos, hlaw⟩ := M5.Period.period_law F hmonic hcoeff
  have hbound := M5.Period.period_cardinality_bound F hmonic hcoeff
  have hdiv : F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus (M5.signaturePeriod F) :=
    (hlaw _).mpr (dvd_refl _)
  refine ⟨M5.signaturePeriod F, ?_⟩
  simp [M5.PeriodSearch.candidates, hdiv, hpos, hbound, Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
queries: Finset min mem min le finite interval
guidance:
Unfold finiteSearch, use candidate_nonempty to select the min branch, then Finset.min'_mem. This certifies an actual positive bounded divisibility candidate; the fallback zero branch is impossible under the original signature assumptions. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
Exact accepted local API:
M5.Period.period_law : ∀ (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → 0 < M5.signaturePeriod F ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N ↔ M5.signaturePeriod F ∣ N
M5.Period.period_cardinality_bound : ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.signaturePeriod F ≤ 2 ^ F.natDegree
M5.Period.period_one : M5.signaturePeriod (1 : M5.BinaryPolynomial) = 1
